description:
Which genes have EMS alleles in every homoeologue, i.e. can be knocked out across A, B and D by crossing
Cadenza/Kronos lines. For each gene (genes: up to 300 symbols or IWGSC IDs, or region: RefSeq v1.0 interval up to
10 Mb, e.g. a QTL) the A/B/D copies come from Ensembl Compara, and each copy gets its lines with a consequence
'truncating' (default; stop, splice donor/acceptor, start/stop lost) or 'missense' etc. Status 'all_copies',
'partial' or 'none'; complete_only keeps 'all_copies'. Kronos lines cover only A and B copies; D copies need
Cadenza. Lines hitting two copies at once are flagged.
name: wheat_knockout_screen
